page.notes: The printed initial on the first paragraph is a large woodcut-style "I" joined to "Ipsa". The line-end words "e-ius" and "præ-mium" keep their printed hyphens. Left-margin references were placed beside the nearest lines; their exact line positions are approximate. Stray marks in the left margin and under the text are not printed text and are omitted. The numbering of the last question is printed as "I." and is kept as printed. The catchword "salute" is read from the foot of the page and is uncertain at its final letter.
